versions.content: DRAFT If EthIf_SetControllerMode is called for an EthIfController with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_TX_OFFLINE and the latest accepted controller mode for this EthIfController is ETH_MODE_ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then ETH_MODE_TX_OFFLINE shall be stor ed as current controller mode. If EthIf_SetControllerMode is called for an EthIfController with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_TX_OFFLINE and the latest accepted controller mode for this EthIfController is ETH_MODE_ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_- REQUEST , then ETH_MODE_TX_OFFLINE shall be stored as current controller mode. Otherwise the requested controller mode shall be rejected and function shall return with E_NOT_OK .
